messages:
claire (docs): Heads up: we need a short grace window for v1 shutdown. Proposal: 12d warn, 6d enforcement. Need model-swap map, snippet fixes, and redirects.

Tom (sdk): Acknowledged. SDK change list: 'model' -> 'model_id' rename, embedding dims altered for a few models, streaming chunk boundary tweak. I'll add a compat layer for 10 days and ship docs examples.

Hazel (devex): Owners: @tom (sdk), @claire (docs), @arjun (oncall). I'll compile a short "what to expect" FAQ for the migration guide and note common gotchas. Can someone grep for any direct /v1/api calls in examples?

Tom (sdk): Quick grep: `rg "\/v1\/invoke|\bmodel\b:\s*\"" docs/ examples/ -n`. I'll open an SDK PR with aliasing examples and one-line rollback command.

Arjun (eng-oncall): I'll prepare the canary and rollback steps. Rollback op: `./tools/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback:migration"`. Canary metric: watch error delta >0.4% -> rollback.

Claire (docs): Docs checklist: 1) deprecation banner + dates; 2) migration quickstart with model map; 3) update js/py/curl snippets; 4) redirect map entry; 5) smoke test link. I'll own 1 & 2.

Hazel (devex): Smoke example for CI:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model_id":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'`
Expect 200 + token_count. I'll add script at /scripts/smoke/migrate_v1v2.sh.

ci-bot: Reminder: PRs must pass code-block-lint and link-check. Broken links will fail CI.

Tom (sdk): I'll include a short snippet in the SDK README showing how to alias old model names: `client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })`. Also adding a unit test accepting both 'model' and 'model_id'.

Claire (docs): Please include a tiny 'what breaks' table: param rename, embed-dim mismatch, streaming framing, and legacy query params removed. Keep fixes copy-paste friendly. Target: soft-deprec announcement tomorrow morning.
